-- Module:WorldBossData
-- The weekly World Boss spawn times. Edit this page when the schedule changes, every timetable on the wiki follows.
--
-- Times are SERVER TIME (America/New_York, so they move with daylight saving like the game does) as day + HH:MM.
-- The timetable converts them to the reader's own time zone.
--
-- slots:  { boss key, day (Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun), time (24 hour) }
-- bosses: name, sub (small text under the name), icons (one file, or two files for a random slot split in half),
--         cls (colour, see Template:WorldBossTimetable/styles.css), ring (true = coloured outline for Primal bosses),
--         parts (the names shown in the table and the page each one links to. A name only becomes a link when
--         that page exists, so there are never red links. Write the page name again here when a boss page is
--         created or renamed. A third value true always links, even before the page exists)

return {
	server = 'America/New_York',

	-- the page the next spawn bar on the Main Page links to
	nextPage = 'World Bosses',

	bosses = {
		rdpa = { name = 'Red Dragon / Primal Anthalon', sub = 'Random', icons = { 'Boss_Red_Dragon.png', 'Boss_Primal_Anthalon.png' }, cls = 'rdpa',
			parts = { { 'Red Dragon', 'Red Dragon' }, { 'Primal Anthalon', 'Primal Anthalon', true } } },
		pa   = { name = 'Primal Anthalon', icons = { 'Boss_Primal_Anthalon.png' }, cls = 'pa', ring = true,
			parts = { { 'Primal Anthalon', 'Primal Anthalon', true } } },
		lev  = { name = 'Leviathan', icons = { 'Boss_Leviathan.png' }, cls = 'lev',
			parts = { { 'Leviathan', 'Leviathan' } } },
		kr   = { name = 'Kraken', icons = { 'Boss_Kraken.png' }, cls = 'kr',
			parts = { { 'Kraken', 'Kraken' } } },
		pkr  = { name = 'Primal Kraken', sub = 'Enhanced Kraken', icons = { 'Boss_Kraken.png' }, cls = 'pkr', ring = true,
			parts = { { 'Primal Kraken', 'Primal Kraken' } } },
		ber  = { name = 'Berserker', icons = { 'Boss_Berserker.png' }, cls = 'ber',
			parts = { { 'Berserker', 'Hanure the Berserker' } } },
		mix  = { name = 'Red Dragon / Kraken / Berserker', sub = 'Random', icons = { 'Boss_Random.png' }, cls = 'mix',
			parts = { { 'Red Dragon', 'Red Dragon' }, { 'Kraken', 'Kraken' }, { 'Berserker', 'Hanure the Berserker' } } },
	},

	slots = {
		{ 'rdpa', 'Mon', '21:30' },
		{ 'lev',  'Mon', '14:00' },
		{ 'kr',   'Mon', '13:30' },
		{ 'rdpa', 'Wed', '13:30' },
		{ 'lev',  'Wed', '14:00' },
		{ 'kr',   'Wed', '21:30' },
		{ 'pa',   'Fri', '17:30' },
		{ 'mix',  'Sat', '05:00' },
		{ 'lev',  'Sat', '14:00' },
		{ 'pkr',  'Sat', '16:30' },
		{ 'ber',  'Sun', '15:30' },
	},
}
